news_items.headline: Union Pacific files amended merger application; projects $3.5B annual shipper savings
news_items.summary: UNP and Norfolk Southern filed an amended merger application on April 30, 2026 with the Surface Transportation Board, projecting $3.5B in annual shipper savings if approved. UNP stated it would exit the deal if STB orders widespread line sales or trackage rights.

news_items.headline: Union Pacific rallies to 52-week high after Q1 earnings beat
news_items.summary: UNP shares rallied to a 52-week high following Q1 results: net income $1.70B / EPS $2.87 on revenue $6.22B, with freight car velocity up 9% to 235 daily miles per car and terminal dwell down 11% to 19.7 hours.

news_items.headline: Union Pacific earnings call highlights record Q1 operational strength
news_items.summary: Q1 net income $1.7B up 5% YoY; EPS $2.87 up 6%. Both operating income and net income set first-quarter records. Management reiterated mid-single-digit reported EPS growth plan for 2026 and 3-year EPS CAGR target of high single-digit to low double-digit through 2027.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: 23-analyst consensus is Buy (32% Strong Buy / 36% Buy / 32% Hold / 0% Sell). 12-month average price target $275.55, ~3% above current price. No specific upgrade/downgrade events surfaced in last 7 days.

earnings_context.notes: Last quarter (Q1 2026) beat with record net income/operating income; street expects mid-single-digit EPS growth in 2026 driven by PSR 2.0 efficiency gains, with the Norfolk Southern merger approval and fuel trends as the next key catalysts to watch.
